# Data Pipeline Research Note 1

Prior research on comparable products shows data pipeline handling of materialize interacts with offset; teams noted that throughput depends on latency and idempotency, especially under real production load. Field notes from three pilot teams confirm data pipeline handling of partition interacts with staleness; teams noted that streaming depends on batch and schema, especially under real production load. Benchmarking across vendors surfaced evidence that data pipeline handling of orchestrator interacts with shard; teams noted that checkpoint depends on lineage and sink, especially under real production load. A literature scan of similar systems found that data pipeline handling of retry interacts with dedupe; teams noted that backfill depends on watermark and transform, especially under real production load.
